title: Custom module
description: Shows fixed text or the output of your own script. Great for buttons, menus and small widgets.

placeholders.description: The "alt" value, when the script outputs JSON.
An icon from "Icons", chosen by the percentage or alt value.

exec.label: Script to run
exec.doc: The path to the script, which should be executed. At most 256 KiB of its output (of each line, if the script runs continuously) is used; the rest is discarded.
exec.description: A command or script whose output is shown in the module. Leave it empty to show only fixed text.

exec-if.label: Only run if
exec-if.doc: The path to a script, which determines if the script in exec should be executed. exec will be executed if the exit code of exec-if equals 0.
exec-if.description: A command that is checked first: the script runs only if this one succeeds.

hide-empty-text.label: Hide when empty
hide-empty-text.doc: Disables the module when output is empty, but format might contain additional static content.
hide-empty-text.description: Hide the module when there is nothing to show.

exec-on-event.label: Run the script again after a click
exec-on-event.doc: If an event command is set (e.g. on-click or on-scroll-up) then re-execute the script after executing the event command.
exec-on-event.description: After running a click or scroll command, update the module right away.

return-type.label: Script output type
return-type.description: Plain text uses each line as the text. JSON lets the script also set the tooltip, a CSS class and a percentage.

interval.label: Run the script every
interval.doc: The interval (in seconds) in which the information gets polled. Minimum value is 0.001 (1ms). Values smaller than 1ms will be set to 1ms. Use once if you want to execute the module only on startup. You can update it manually with a signal. If no interval or signal is defined, it is assumed that the out script loops itself. If both interval and signal are defined, the script keeps running every interval and a signal triggers an extra update in between.
interval.description: How often the script runs again. Leave empty if the script keeps running by itself.

restart-interval.label: Restart after
restart-interval.doc: The restart interval (in seconds). Minimum value is 0.001 (1ms). Values smaller than 1ms will be set to 1ms. Can't be used with the interval option, so only with continuous scripts. Once the script exits, it'll be re-executed after the restart-interval.
restart-interval.description: If the script stops, start it again after this time.

signal.label: Refresh signal
signal.doc: The signal number used to update the module. The number is valid between 1 and N, where SIGRTMIN+N = SIGRTMAX. If no interval is defined, or it is set to once, the script runs once on startup and a signal is the only way to update the module.
signal.description: Refresh the module when it receives this signal number (for example with pkill -RTMIN+8 waybar).

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed. On {text} data gets inserted.
format.description: The text in the bar. Write anything (an icon, a word) or use {text} to show what your script prints.

format-icons.label: Icons
format-icons.doc: If the type is an array, then based on the set percentage, the corresponding icon gets selected (the order is low to high). If the type is an object, then the icon is selected according to the alt string from the output. If the type is a string, it is pasted as is. Arrays can be nested into objects: icons are then selected first according to alt, then percentage.
format-icons.description: The icons used for {icon}. When it is a list, the first icon is used for the lowest level and the last one for the highest.

rotate.label: Rotation
rotate.doc: Positive value to rotate the text label (in 90 degree increments).
rotate.description: Rotate the text. Mostly useful on vertical bars.

max-length.label: Maximum length
max-length.doc: The maximum length in character the module should display.
max-length.description: Cut the text when it is longer than this. Empty means no limit.

min-length.label: Minimum length
min-length.doc: The minimum length in characters the module should accept.
min-length.description: Keep the module at least this wide, so the bar doesn't jump around when the text changes.

align.label: Text position
align.doc: The alignment of the label within the module, where 0 is left-aligned and 1 is right-aligned. If the module is rotated, it will follow the flow of the text.
align.description: Where the text sits inside the module: 0 is left, 0.5 is center, 1 is right.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's label, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: Command to execute when clicked on the module.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: Command to execute when middle-clicked on the module using mousewheel.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: Command to execute when you right-click on the module.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

on-scroll-up.label: Scroll up runs
on-scroll-up.doc: Command to execute when scrolling up on the module.
on-scroll-up.description: A command to run when you scroll up over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

on-scroll-down.label: Scroll down runs
on-scroll-down.doc: Command to execute when scrolling down on the module.
on-scroll-down.description: A command to run when you scroll down over the module. It replaces what scrolling normally does.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltip on hover.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The tooltip format. If specified, overrides any tooltip output from the script in exec. Uses the same format replacements as format.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

escape.label: Show special characters literally
escape.doc: Option to enable escaping of script output.
escape.description: Show characters like < and & as they are, instead of treating them as formatting.

menu.label: Open popup menu with
menu.description: Which click opens a popup menu for this module.

menu-file.label: Menu layout file
menu-file.doc: Location of the menu descriptor file. There need to be an element of type GtkMenu with id menu
menu-file.description: The file that describes the menu entries (a GTK .xml file with a menu called "menu").

menu-actions.label: Menu commands
menu-actions.doc: The actions corresponding to the buttons of the menu.
menu-actions.description: For each menu entry, the command to run when you pick it.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

image-path.label: Image file
image-path.doc: Path to an image file to display in the module.
image-path.description: Show a picture from a file in the module.

image-name.label: Icon name
image-name.doc: Name of a themed icon to display in the module.
image-name.description: Show an icon from your icon theme, by its name.

icon-size.label: Image size
icon-size.doc: The size (in pixels) of the image set via image-path or image-name.
icon-size.description: The size (in pixels) of the image set via image-path or image-name.
